item.title: Mbappé dropped by major Chinese brands drop as backlash grows over Mao joke
item.description: A backlash has erupted on Chinese social media over Mbappé's comments on a "Chinese dictator" [Getty Images] Several Chinese brands have dropped French footballer Kylian Mbappé following a backlash over alleged comments referring to the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong. Mbappé reportedly told a French talk show The Bridge the meme "that makes me laugh the most, it's the one where there's a video of a guy, I think it's a Chinese dictator..." As he trails off, a meme of his face superimposed on an image resembling Mao appears. The Real Madrid forward's nickname, "the dictator", because of his huge influence is a popular meme and a running joke. But the joke did not go down well in China, where Mao is revered by the Communist Party, despite his chaotic and often violent rule that left millions dead. The BBC has reached out to Mbappe and Real Madrid for comment. The Bridge is hosted by Mbappé's Real Madrid teammate Aurélien Tchouaméni. The original video is not available on the show's YouTube channel, and it's unclear when the interview first aired. In the unverified clips that have been circulating online, Mbappé does not identify Mao by name. He says he "uses [the meme] with friends all the time". The furore appeared to kick off on Monday night after Chinese football forum Dongqiudi drew attention to the comments in a statement, saying they were "inappropriate" and "hurt the feelings of Chinese people". Screengrabs of the clip and meme have since spread quickly on Chinese social media, with people echoing this sentiment and even calling for a boycott of both the French striker and his club, Real Madrid. But some have blurred the meme itself as well as the part of the comment they found offensive, when Mbappe refers to "a Chinese dictator". Dongqiudi said in its statement that it was "unable to translate" his comments because they were "offensive to China and the Chinese people". So, many people are also wondering what exactly Mbappe said and have responded to the angry posts and comments with questions, wanting to know more. Weibo users are recirculating the clip by blurring the meme and redacting references to Mao [Weibo] What is the reaction in China? Chinese fans are criticising Mbappé – who is popular in China as and has huge brand endorsements – of "profiting from the Chinese market yet making remarks that offend the Chinese public". "International public figures, in particular, should show greater respect and sensitivity, as national sentiment must never be taken lightly," reads another comment on Weibo. As the anger online grew louder, Chinese brands began to cut ties, although they did not explicitly refer to the video. The country's largest dairy producer, Mengniu, said it "firmly opposes and has a zero-tolerance policy towards any words or actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people". item.title: 'Everyone knows he was the best' - Lamine Yamal's uncle slams Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or victory in fierce defence of Barcelona star
item.description: Harry Kane - Getty Images Lamine Yamal's uncle has publicly criticised the decision to award Harry Kane the Ballon d'Or ahead of the Barcelona winger. He controversially claimed that true football fans pay money specifically to watch his nephew play, rather than the Bayern Munich and England striker. Kane claims the ultimate individual prize Kane made history on Monday evening at the Palladium Theatre in London. The Bayern striker became the first Englishman to win the Ballon d'Or since Michael Owen claimed the honour in 2001. The prestigious award was kept a closely guarded secret until Brazil legend Ronaldo revealed Kane as the winner. Real Madrid and France forward Kylian Mbappe finished in second place. Barcelona winger Yamal completed the podium in third. The 19-year-old was visibly upset when Kane collected the trophy, although the Spanish international did secure the Young Talent of the Year award for a third consecutive year. Yamal's uncle issues brutal Kane verdict The final voting results did not sit well with Yamal's family. Speaking to El Larguero , his uncle, Abdul Abdellaoui, expressed his deep frustration over the perceived snub. Abdellaoui insisted that the Barcelona star was robbed of his first Ballon d'Or. "My nephew was amazing, he was the best player in the world, everyone knows it," Abdul stated. "If you like football, you go to see Lamine, not Harry Kane. Harry Kane is a great goalscorer but Lamine is the best player who shines on the pitch." Age played a major voting factor Yamal enjoyed a phenomenal year for both club and country. He helped Barcelona secure the Liga title before playing a starring role in Spain's World Cup triumph over the summer. Despite these major trophies, Abdul believes his nephew was overlooked entirely due to his youth. He feels voters opted to reward the veteran England captain instead. "Since Lamine is young, they always say he has time, he's 19, and that's why they're not giving him the award," Abdul explained. "Harry, with only three days of football left, they're saying, 'come on, we'll give him the award'. He [Yamal] has won the World Cup, La Liga, the Super Cup, he plays really well." Looking ahead to future Ballon d'Or glory While the immediate aftermath has been bitterly disappointing for Yamal, his trajectory remains frighteningly steep. He is widely expected to claim the top prize at some point during his promising career. The Barca academy graduate will now channel his frustration back into his club football. The sadness of missing out to Kane is expected to be short-lived as he focuses on adding more silverware to his collection.

item.description: Ballon d'Or Kylian Mbappe Harry Kane - Getty Images Harry Kane has officially been crowned the world's best player, but the Bayern Munich striker only secured the Ballon d'Or by the narrowest of margins. New revelations from French Football chief Vincent Garcia suggest that the England captain was actually trailing his rivals for a significant portion of the polling period. Late surge secures historic win Kane claimed football's ultimate individual prize at a glitzy London ceremony , ending England's 25-year wait for a male Ballon d'Or winner. The Bayern Munich marksman pipped Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal to the Golden Ball following a career-best goalscoring campaign. However, the triumph did not come without immense tension behind the scenes. While Kane, Mbappe, and Yamal were heavily tipped as the primary contenders, an embarrassing administrative blunder briefly sparked confusion when all three were prematurely listed as winners on the official website hours before the event. Ultimately, Kane took home the official prize to emulate Michael Owen's 2001 achievement. Mbappe had to settle for a career-best second-place finish. The Real Madrid forward dominated the global scoring charts across La Liga, the Champions League, and the World Cup, yet remains without a Golden Ball on his glittering CV. France Football chief explains tight vote The battle for this year's award was exceptionally close. France Football editor Vincent Garcia offered a rare glimpse into the polling process, confirming that the Bayern Munich forward was not the frontrunner for much of the voting window. "I was watching the results in real time during the month of the vote," Garcia told L'Equipe . "Kylian Mbappe led the race for a long time, but Harry Kane came back into contention, and in the end, it was decided by a very, very small number of points." Kane reflects on difficult journey to the top Upon accepting the accolade, the former Tottenham captain reflected on his unconventional path to global dominance. Unlike many modern prodigies, the 33-year-old had to grind through the lower leagues before establishing himself at the elite level. "It's just the journey," Kane said. "For any young boy or girl who wants to achieve their dream, anything is possible. item.title: Why Bukayo Saka won the 2026 Socrates Award
item.description: Why Bukayo Saka won the 2026 Socrates Award Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka received the Socrates Award at the 2026 Ballon d’Or ceremony on Monday night, recognising his humanitarian work through the year. Photo via Arsenal.com Arsenal weren’t big winners at the Ballon d’Or ceremony on Monday night, but Bukayo Saka was the one Gunner to receive an award. Saka was handed the Socrates Award for his humanitarian work in 2026, with plenty of reported examples of the winger’s efforts to help people. The Ballon d’Or website notes Saka’s donation of over a thousand school uniforms to four schools in Ealing, and his donation of 100 pairs of football boots to participants at the Street Soccer Academy – an organisation aiming to tackle youth homelessness. Photo via Arsenal.com Arsenal highlight Saka’s work with Big Shoe, providing medical care and humanitarian aid for children and families in London and around the world, including emergency housing for families displaced by the earthquakes in Turkey and Morocco. Saka’s work has also helped more than 100 children in Africa with surgeries they wouldn’t otherwise have been able to have. Big Shoe report on their website that Saka has helped provide health check-ups for more than 580 children in Rwanda, and health insurance for more than 1,000 people, as well as providing clean drinking water, a Girls’ Room, a renovated football pitch, stand, and library at GSU Mbati school. Photo via Arsenal.com Speaking after receiving the award, Saka said: “I would like to thank France Football for the opportunity to be here tonight to keep raising awareness of these causes that are close to my heart. “I’d love to share with you a story from the Big Shoe charity, that’s helped change a kid’s life, in his own words… “‘To everyone here tonight, my name is Biringiro, I’m 14 years old and I live in a village in Rwanda. I want to share my story with you. “When I was 12, I started losing my sight. My village has no electricity, and as my eyesight got worse, even moving around my home became difficult. At school, I couldn’t read what my teachers wrote on the blackboard and I struggled to play with my friends. I just wanted to play freely and feel like every other child. “Then, thanks to Big Shoe, I received the eye care that I needed. Today, I can read the blackboard, even from the back of the classroom. But more importantly, I no longer need to worry about feeling different. I can enjoy being a child again. For the first time in a long time, I’m excited about my future. I want to become an English teacher one day. “I know many of you here tonight have achieved your childhood dreams, and now I believe I can achieve mine too. May God bless you all abundantly, with love and gratitude, Biringiro.'” Photo by Alex Grimm/Getty Images

item.title: Bayern still without Neuer and Musiala for Cup clash at Magdeburg
item.description: FILE PHOTO - Bayern Munich goalkeeper Manuel Neuer takes part in the team’s final training session ahead of Wednesday’s UEFA Champions League soccer match against Arsenal. (is associated with: «Bayern still without Neuer and Musiala for Cup clash at Magdeburg») Angelika Warmuth/dpa Bayern Munich will still be without goalkeeper Manuel Neuer and midfielder Jamal Musiala for the German Cup second round match against Magdeburg on Wednesday. "It's still a bit too early for Manuel Neuer and Jamal Musiala. The players had their treatment yesterday and we'll have to wait and see. We still need to speak to the doctors and then see who's available," assistant coach Aaron Danks said in a news conference on Tuesday. Neuer has been dealing with persistent tendonitis in his foot, while Musiala is not fit yet following a torn muscle fibre injury. Joshua Kimmich is also out, but expected to resume training this week after a family bereavement. He added, however, that defender Minjae Kim and midfielder Aleksandar Pavlović are "certainly a bit closer to being fit." Danks is deputizing for coach Vincent Kompany, who's in hospital since last Friday after collapsing during Bayern's reserve team training session. "I popped in to see Vincent briefly yesterday, he's in good spirits. It looks as though things are improving day by day. There's no definitive prognosis. He's very calm and is being given plenty of time to recover," Danks said. Bayern are in celebration mode after Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or on Monday evening and will try to bring the good momentum into the Cup match and also into the Bundesliga table-topper against Borussia Dortmund on Saturday. "I can't say I was overly confident - he had to hold his own against top players. The margins were very tight. We work very closely with him and see the effort he puts in. I'm really delighted for him," Danks said. "As an Englishman, I'm not entirely impartial here. But I see how hard he works every day. I'm delighted for him and also for the club, it shows what the club stands for. He'll now come back and carry on in his usual professional and humble way."

item.description: Motorsport photo Davide Tardozzi has defended Marc Marquez amid the uncertainty surrounding MotoGP’s upcoming visit to Qatar, for which riders have asked the championship organisers to provide guarantees over their safety. MotoGP faces several challenges as the 2026 season approaches its conclusion, but few appear more pressing than the championship’s imminent trip to Qatar. Following this weekend’s Malaysian Grand Prix, the paddock will head to the Lusail International Circuit for an event that has remained in doubt until the last minute. The ongoing conflict in the Middle East, with the war between the United States and Israel on one side and Iran on the other still raging, has cast doubt over several sporting events scheduled to take place in the region. For example, ASO, the organiser of the Dakar Rally, confirmed on Sunday what had long been expected: the 2027 edition of the event will not take place in Saudi Arabia . In MotoGP’s case, the Qatar Grand Prix, originally scheduled for earlier in the season, had to be postponed until the weekend of 6-8 November. As the date has approached, championship officials have reiterated their intention to travel to the Losail circuit despite the tense situation. Liberty Media, the owner of MotoGP Sports Entertainment Group, has adopted the same stance regarding Formula 1, its other championship, with the final two rounds of the 2026 season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi still scheduled to go ahead despite the uncertainty. The situation has naturally raised concerns among those involved in the championships, including MotoGP riders. As Motorsport.com reported a few days ago , riders privately expressed their views on travelling to Qatar after the Indonesian Grand Prix, with three-quarters of the grid opposed to the trip. This prompted them to meet with championship officials at Phillip Island during the Australian Grand Prix weekend to request assurances for the Losail event, with their safety the overriding priority. Although several riders have voiced opposition to travelling to Qatar, many are particularly interested in hearing the position of Marquez, the nine-time world champion and still the most influential rider in the premier class. Mason, who transferred from Division II Central Oklahoma this offseason with little fanfare, wasn’t listed on OSU’s two deep depth chart to begin the season. In Saturday's win vs Colorado , the Coweta graduate was the first running back to score. Mason rushed in for a 3-yard touchdown midway through the third quarter that lifted OSU’s lead to 37-24. He now has 11 carries for 73 yards this season. More: Drew Mestemaker plays role of 'big brother' for Oklahoma State football defense OSU coach Eric Morris said Mason has been OSU’s best special teams player this season. He took whatever his role was, and he dominated it. item.description: Ohio State Buckeyes forward Ella Hobbs (14) shoots the ball against the Kent State Golden Flashes in the first half at Value City Arena on Wednesday, Nov. 19, 2025 in Columbus, Ohio. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co A focus of Ohio State women’s basketball recruiting over the previous three seasons is building strength inside the paint. The Buckeyes struggled over four seasons to establish any sort of rebounding consistency. In addition, interior threats over that time more or less had their way with the Scarlet and Gray’s interior defense. Since 2024 though, head coach Kevin McGuff brought in players to turn the tide back in Ohio State’s favor. Buckeye interiors that were once occupied by players like Jantel Lavender and more recently Dorka Juhász now features players like Elsa Lemmilä and Kylee Kitts. However, there is one player who has not featured much over the last two seasons who has attributes that fit well into Ohio State’s system, especially on offense. It’s redshirt sophomore Ella Hobbs. item.title: Antonelli admits Verstappen's early pit stop left him concerned in Austin
item.description: Kimi Antonelli has admitted that Max Verstappen 's early pit stop at the United States Grand Prix worried him. The Mercedes driver also said the one-stop strategy that won him the race was decided during the race and was not the plan from the start. Verstappen criticised the call heavily after the race, but the winner's version suggests the early stop looked like a real threat when Red Bull made it. In the end, Antonelli's victory was not threatened by the Dutchman, who is now a single point away from winning this year's title. Antonelli was 'a bit concerned' when Mercedes stayed out Red Bull pitted Verstappen on Lap 13 and fitted a second set of soft tyres, committing him to a two-stop race. Mercedes kept Antonelli out on mediums, and he said he was "a bit concerned in the beginning" by that choice. "But we were able to extend and actually the pace came back with the medium, and we were able to extend without losing too much time. So then, as you know, after doing the first stint on the medium, we were like, 'Oh, right, we're going to go for one-stop.' And the hard, to be fair, felt very robust, so I felt pretty confident to go all the way to the end." The Italian added that he "just didn't know how much management was required, but it was good, and the car felt very good today." Why the two strategies split The tyres each team had left also played a part. Verstappen had saved two sets of softs from qualifying, which seemed to give him a strategic advantage before the start, while Mercedes had no new softs left. Photo: Race Pictures Photo: Race Pictures "We didn't have much choice, to be fair. We didn't have any new softs, so the new medium was the only choice we really had, or the hard," Antonelli added. From the outside, then, Red Bull's early stop looked like a sensible way to use a tyre advantage, and the leader took it seriously. The trouble came later. Verstappen ran into a more problematic second stint on softs, and he was already stuck on a two-stop by then. Red Bull put the drop in pace down to hidden damage . Antonelli only lost the lead after his single stop, which dropped him behind Verstappen and Leclerc. He went back in front when Verstappen made his second stop, and Leclerc did not put up much of a fight once Antonelli caught him. Title within reach in Mexico Antonelli now heads to Mexico with a strong chance of wrapping up the championship, especially after teammate George Russell was only finished in eighth place at COTA. Antonelli is just two points shy of claiming his first F1 title in Mexico City.

item.title: ‘Like clockwork’ – NBA fans show no sympathy for Wizards as Anthony Davis gets injured
item.description: Photo by David Jensen/Getty Images NBA fans are showing no love to Anthony Davis after the Washington Wizards star appeared to have injured his hand. The Washington Wizards continue to have a rocky start to the regular season as they have dropped to a 2-2 record following a 110-103 defeat at the hands of the Charlotte Hornets. For Wizards fans, though, the loss wasn’t the biggest takeaway from the matchup. Instead, it was star forward Anthony Davis seemingly suffering an injury at the end of the game. NBA fans react to Anthony Davis’ apparent hand injury When healthy, Davis is regarded as one of the most dominant two-way players in the NBA. Unfortunately, the 33-year-old has a history of injury troubles. As a result, many fans were skeptical of the Wizards welcoming AD to the roster. item.title: How many players LIV Golf are claiming have verbally committed to signing with the league for 2027
item.description: Photo by Hector Vivas/Getty Images Players who are unsure about whether to stay with LIV Golf for 2027 are apparently being told by the league’s leadership that they have received verbal commitments from up to 30 others. It has been an extremely bleak time for those associated with LIV Golf, with a raft of names declaring last week that they do not intend to stay with the league next season. Several big names have already confirmed that they will be leaving, including Jon Rahm, Tyrrell Hatton, and Louis Oosthuizen. Both Rahm and Oosthuizen had been captains of their respective teams. Meanwhile, Richard Bland, Cameron Tringale, Brendan Steele, and Ben Campbell have announced that they will be playing on LIV next year. Despite being LIV’s biggest cheerleader during the 2026 season, Bryson DeChambeau is yet to publicly announce that he is going nowhere. Interestingly, those working behind the scenes on LIV believe that many more players are ready to sign up for 2.0. Up to 30 players have reportedly committed to joining LIV 2.0 According to Flushing It on X , LIV higher-ups are telling undecided players that up to 30 golfers have already verbally agreed to stay. Alarmingly for LIV, however, Flushing It noted that the reality may be quite different. They wrote: ‘ LIV Golf leadership have in recent weeks told players who are on the fence that they have “25-30 verbal commitments”. But it’s unclear how many, if any, have actually signed yet and my sourcing suggests that the true number will be considerably less. Relegated players have also already been approached about commitment for 2027. ‘ Any hope LIV Golf had of being taken seriously has been dashed As a serious golf league, it appears that LIV is completely finished. They struggled for credibility throughout their existence, but could at least point to some of the stars they had and argue that they deserved some respect. DeChambeau, Cam Smith, and Dustin Johnson are among the players yet to confirm their next moves publicly. So it may well be that LIV retains a number of their biggest names. However, it is difficult to see why any golfer who prioritises being the best player they can possibly be would have any reason to sign with LIV. Clearly, the purses are still likely to be quite high. And if you are playing in events that include 50 journeymen golfers, you are going to be able to make a lot of money. But the best players predominantly play on the PGA Tour, while the best global schedule takes you to the DP World Tour. It is telling that very few have spoken out with any enthusiasm about the idea of signing up for LIV 2.0.

item.title: Bills pass offense about to undergo a specific two-week test
item.description: The Buffalo Bills offense has been very good in 2026. Thank goodness for that, because the Bills defense has been bad. A bye week is just what the doctor ordered to get the defensive side of the ball hopefully on a better path for the remainder of the 2026 season, but the Bills passing offense is the unit that will be put under an unexpected microscope as the team prepares to face the Baltimore Ravens and Minnesota Vikings over the next two weeks. Lost in the greatest of quarterback Josh Allen and the Bills expectedly-productive passing attack in 2026 is that it has come with it a strong performance for the unit against the blitz. In 2025, Josh Allen against the blitz registered the following results (amongst 41 QBs with at least 50 drop backs): 21st in success rate 27th in completion percentage over expected (CPOE) 19th in adjusted completion percentage 30th (lower is worse) in off-target throw rate 14th in expected points added (EPA) per drop back In 2026, those numbers have jumped up notably to: 4th in success rate 9th in CPOE 9th in adjusted completion percentage 14th (lower is worse) in off-target throw rate 2nd in EPA per drop back One of the most notable differences in results in the Bills offense in 2026 with former offensive coordinator Joe Brady at the helm as head coach is the passing game’s performance against the blitz, and this new trick couldn’t have come at a better time, because two of the most blitz-happy teams in the National Football League are on the docket for the next two Buffalo Bills games. The Baltimore Ravens have blitzed opposing offenses on 36.5% of opposing plays (8th most in the NFL), while defensive coordinator Brian Flores and the Minnesota Vikings continue to absolutely shell shock offenses with a staggering 73.9% of the time (handedly #1 in the league). The results from each team’s blitzing has been different, though, and we should judge the Bills performance against each team’s blitz differently. The Ravens are 23rd in the league in EPA per play allowed when blitzing, and the Vikings are 4th in the NFL in that same metric. In fact, the Ravens have a statistically significant delta between their EPA per play allowed when blitzing (+0.16) and when rushing with four (-0.02), so each team can be considered “blitz heavy”, but a.) not to even close to the same degree and b.) to not the same degree of effectiveness. Each one will provide a test against a Bills team that has only faced one defense that’s inside the top 10 in blitz rate (New England, #5 at 41.3%) and produced a season low success rate of 45.5% in that game. The Bills have been good overall against the blitz in 2026, but they’ve only had to deal with a single blitz-heavy team and it produced their only loss of the season. The next two weeks will go far to outline if the team is actually much better against the blitz compared to 2025 or if they just haven’t faced enough blitz experts. …and that’s the way the cookie crumbles. item.description: Just ten kilometres from Brisbane Road, where he scored his first professional goal in England’s third tier, Harry Kane collected the biggest individual prize in men’s football on Monday night at the star-studded London Palladium Theatre. The Bayern Munich striker becomes the first England player to win the Ballon d’Or since 2001, and English fans were quick to celebrate. Kane could hardly believe it himself. “Not many people would have thought that, and maybe even I wouldn’t have thought that I could get this far,” he told streaming service DAZN. He added that he was never the sort of player expected to become a superstar. English footballer Harry Kane receives the men's player of the year award during the Ballon d'Or ceremony at the London Palladium Theatre in London. - Copyright 2026 The Associated Press. All rights reserved Seventy-three goals in 65 matches for Bayern and the England national team was, in the view of the journalists' jury, unsurpassed last season: not by Kylian Mbappé, Lionel Messi, Lamine Yamal or Rodri. Kane's award also ended a long barren spell for the Bundesliga. The last time a player active in Germany was honoured with the Ballon d'Or was in 1996, when Matthias Sammer won it. For Bayern, Kane is the first recipient since Karl-Heinz Rummenigge, who took the prize in 1981. Bayern president Herbert Hainer called it a proud day for the club. “Harry Kane can do everything, and he scores goals, goals, goals,” he said, adding that Kane now stands alongside Franz Beckenbauer, Gerd Müller and Rummenigge. He also thanked the people who have supported him in recent years. They include Bayern coach Vincent Kompany, who could not travel after collapsing on Friday, and Thomas Tuchel, his former Bayern coach and now England manager. Tuchel said he ran out of superlatives for Kane’s performances long ago, but was delighted to see the football world recognise them officially. Some of these academy players progress straight into Liverpool's first team , like Rio Ngumoha and Trey Nyoni, but for many others going on loan is a massive part of the development process in Merseyside. Several stars have been sent out on loan before becoming first-team regulars at Anfield in recent years, with Jarell Quansah, Harvey Elliott and Conor Bradley just some examples. The Reds have 11 players out on loan currently, but how are they getting on? How are Liverpool's loanees doing? item.description: Bruno Fernandes has not been at his best this season, but he will not be easy to replace... When Bruno Fernandes publicly called out Michael Carrick for his tactics after the 4-1 loss in Como, it felt like a new low for Manchester United . Since the Glazer family purchased the club in 2005, there have been many low points, but you would do well to find one in which the club captain and another first-team player went against the manager and directors within weeks of each other. Fernandes was an unused substitute in Manchester United's 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth at Old Trafford on Sunday afternoon – a game that will be remembered more for the fans' reaction to Michael Carrick and the players walking down the tunnel than for what happened on the pitch. At the time of writing, Carrick remains in charge at Old Trafford and has reported for training on Tuesday morning, though the situation could rapidly change. Manchester United have been linked with Antonio Conte, Eddie Howe, and Julian Nagelsmann in recent days, which could be enough for Bruno Fernandes to seek a move away from the club. Fernandes "increasingly unhappy" at Man Utd Bruno Fernandes moved to Old Trafford when Ole Gunnar Solskjær was in the dugout. Since then, he has played under Michael Carrick (interim), Ralf Rangnick (interim), Erik ten Hag, Ruud Van Nistelrooy (interim), Rúben Amorim, Darren Fletcher (interim), and Michael Carrick again. Counting both of Michael Carrick's stints, that is eight managers since January 2020, with a ninth looking set to be appointed before Christmas. With that in mind, Calcio Mercato has reported that the Portuguese international is becoming "increasingly unhappy" at Old Trafford, noting his post-Como criticism as significant. Carrick insisted that Fernandes' non-appearance against Bournemouth was purely down to "football decisions", though it is difficult not to read more into it. Contract talks seemed to be on the agenda during the summer, but they never progressed, and Fernandes could leave Old Trafford in 2027. item.title: ‘Be shocked if he didn’t end up at Georgia’: Analyst expects Arch Manning to leave Texas
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Arch Manning entered the season as a Heisman Trophy favorite and a potential top pick in the 2027 NFL Draft. Now, one former ESPN analyst doesn’t think he’ll even be at Texas next year. Former College GameDay analyst David Pollack said this weekend that, unless things “turn around crazy,” Manning won’t be back with the Longhorns in 2027. Pollack also said an SEC head coach told him he’d be “shocked” if Manning didn’t end up at Georgia. Manning’s Rough Season Texas is 5-2 after beating No. 7 Ole Miss on Saturday, but it’s been a bumpy ride for Manning. The Longhorns lost back-to-back games to Oklahoma and Florida by identical 27-24 scores, with costly late turnovers from Manning in both. After the loss to Florida, Texas reportedly began preparing for a potential quarterback change, and head coach Steve Sarkisian warned Manning that he would make a change unless he showed something different. Manning responded with three total touchdowns against Ole Miss, but he also had three turnovers in the game and the offense slowed down considerably in the second half of the game. Despite the win, Manning and the Longhorns still have a tall task ahead of them with a difficult schedule and mounting injuries to star players. ‘Arch Ain’t Gonna Be There Next Year’ Speaking with Takeo Spikes on Bleacher Report, Pollack predicted that Manning will be playing somewhere else next season. “Unless this turns around crazy, Arch ain’t gonna be there next year,” Pollack said, via Bleacher Report . “Like, I don’t think he’ll be in Texas.” That said, Pollack thinks that Manning’s departure from Texas will be an “amicable split” with no animosity from either side. “And I think Arch will be excited, and as long as Sark’s there it will probably be an amicable split,” Pollack said. He also said he’s heard where Manning could end up. “I had a head coach in the SEC tell me he’d be shocked if he didn’t end up at Georgia,” Pollack said. “Because, remember he committed to Georgia.” It’s worth noting that Pollack’s statement isn’t totally accurate. Georgia recruited Manning heavily, but he never actually committed to Georgia out of high school. That said, it would make sense as a possible transfer destination for both the Bulldogs and Manning. Say what you want about officiating or controversial fourth down decisions, but the Lions led for the majority of that game, and made the final, critical plays to push them over the top. So let’s talk about the most impressive accomplishments from the Lions’ 20-17 victory over the Packers. Today’s Question of the Day is: What was the Lions’ most impressive part of their win over the Packers? My answer: The easiest answer would be to talk about Detroit’s pass defense, which limited Jordan Love’s ability to push the ball downfield. While I thought the linebackers struggled in coverage over the middle, Detroit’s secondary played their best game of the season. According to PFF, all of the defensive backs combined were just responsible for nine catches of 19 targets for only 82 yards, 0 TDs, 1 INT, and two pass breakups. And Love’s overall efficiency was among his worst performances of the year. Going into the game, here’s what Love averaged through six weeks: 91.8 passer rating 7.5 yards per attempt 0.131 dropback EPA 42.9 dropback success rate And here’s how he performed against the Lions: 83.0 passer rating 6.1 yards per attempt 0.142 dropback EPA 35.4% dropback success rate Credit to the Lions’ defensive backs, and the smart strategy to rotate them and keep them fresh. But I also want to talk about the flip side of the ball. Detroit’s passing offense was spectacular against what was one of the best passing defenses through six weeks of the season. Going into the game, the Packers were allowing: 73.9 passer rating 5.9 yards per attempt -0.024 dropback EPA 45.5% success rate And here’s what Jared Goff and company did to that defense: 119.7 passer rating 9.5 yards per attempt 0.399 dropback EPA 57.1% success rate They absolutely blew them out of the water in a way Green Bay had not yet experienced this year. It wasn’t perfect, and the Lions were certainly slowed down in the second half, but that was still a damn impressive game from Goff and company. That should give Lions fans confidence that the offense should be able to move the ball relatively well even against some elite defenses. And what do you know?
